description: Turn Markdown into Word, Excel and HTML files that people outside engineering can open, turn their files back into Markdown, and render diagrams to images. Standard-library Python scripts, with nothing to install.

prerequisites: A Markdown file with a heading or two, and a table if you want a spreadsheet
first-value.starter-task: Send a Markdown report as a Word document and its tables as a spreadsheet
first-value.starter-prompt: Convert reports/q3-review.md to a Word document for the Acme account team, and put its tables in an Excel workbook for finance.
first-value.verification: md-to-docx writes q3-review.docx with the headings in Word's navigation pane and a WARN line for anything it dropped, and md-to-xlsx writes q3-review.xlsx with one sheet per table, numbers typed as numbers, and a frozen, filtered header row.
first-value.recovery: If the script says python3 is not found, install Python 3.9 or later. If a skill does not activate, ask for it by name ("use md-to-docx"). If a table lands as text, read the per-sheet counts md-to-xlsx printed: a unit typed inside the number cells is the usual cause.

journey.when: Your draft is in Markdown, but the people who need it work in Word, Excel or a browser, or they sent you their files and you want to work on them as Markdown.
you_bring: the Markdown draft, or the Word, PDF, Excel or HTML files you were sent
any Mermaid diagrams the draft contains
a brand.json from brand-kit, if the Word file should be in your brand
who it is for, and whether they edit it, calculate with it or only read it

steps.you_do: If you start from someone else's files, hand them over.
steps.you_get: Markdown you can edit and diff, with a count of what could not come across (images, charts, comments, formulas, tracked changes).

steps.you_do: Run it on the finished draft before it leaves the team.
steps.you_get: The draft with invisible characters and generated-by trailers stripped, and machine-sounding lines flagged with rewrites.

steps.you_do: If the draft has Mermaid diagrams, render them.
steps.you_get: Each diagram checked for the errors that stop it rendering, then an SVG or PNG per diagram to embed in the Word or HTML version (PNG and SVG need mermaid-cli installed).

steps.you_do: Convert the draft for readers who will edit or comment in Word.
steps.you_get: A .docx with real headings, live links, tables and embedded images, plus a list of anything dropped.
steps.decide: Send it, or fix the warnings in the Markdown and convert again.

steps.you_do: Convert the tables for readers who will filter or total them.
steps.you_get: A .xlsx with one sheet per table, typed numbers, dates and percentages, and formulas off unless you ask.

steps.you_do: Convert the draft for readers who only need to read it in a browser.
steps.you_get: One self-contained, print-friendly HTML file with images embedded, so it still works when emailed.

journey.you_end_with: The same content in the format each reader uses, with nothing dropped silently, and a Markdown source you can keep editing.
